items.statement: The submission independently performs and documents a converged optimization for neutral singlet M3 and validates the stationary point or reports bounded failure.
items.expected: A reproducible optimization with convergence evidence and correct charge/multiplicity, with minimum validation or an explicit limitation.

items.statement: The submission constructs a physically justified molecular frame and measures planarity and the shortest chemically relevant N···S contact.
items.expected: Explicit frame/axis construction and object-specific structural metrics from the optimized geometry.

items.statement: The submission reports the complete quadrupole tensor and the component along its independently assigned stacking axis.
items.expected: Qxx, Qyy and stacking-axis component in Debye, with convention and origin disclosed.

items.statement: The submission states whether its independent results support a planar, net-dipole-cancelled quadrupolar description.
items.expected: A calculation-based structural/electrostatic interpretation with explicit uncertainty and scope limits.
